partners.mechanism_chain: ACO2 (HGNC:242) —DISRUPTS→ TCA cycle (REACT:R-HSA-70127); TCA cycle (REACT:R-HSA-70127) —DECREASES→ Succinate (CHEBI:17798); Succinate (CHEBI:17798) —DECREASES→ Mitochondrial ATP synthesis (GO:0006670); ATP5F1A (HGNC:9596) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial ATP synthesis (GO:0006670); Mitochondrial ATP synthesis (GO:0006670) —LEADS_TO→ Encephalopathy (HP:0001295); Mitochondrial ATP synthesis (GO:0006670) —LEADS_TO→ Hypotonia (HP:0001252).
